Printed edition: An heroic epistle to the right honourable the Lord Craven, on his delivering the following sentence at the county meeting at Abingdon, on Tuesday November 7, 1775 "I will have it known there is respect due to a lord".  1775, 1775, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/bim_eighteenth-century_an-heroic-epistle-to-the_combe-william_1775_0.
